name: 4x4 UKG skippy hats
desc: Four-to-the-floor speed-garage kit: pumping 909 kick, claps on 2 and 4, a 16th skippy 707 hat figure that rotates through the bar via iter, shaker euclid walking its offset, phrase-end clap doubles.

rate.doc: pattern rate multiplier, bare JS arg

code.full: stack(s("bd*4").bank("RolandTR909").shape(.25).gain(${gain}), s("~ cp ~ cp").bank("RolandTR909").gain(${gain}*.7).room(.15), s("[hh hh ~ hh] [~ hh hh ~] [hh ~ hh hh] [~ hh <hh oh> ~]").bank("RolandTR707").gain("[.5 .28 .38 .25]*4").late("[0 .018]*8").iter(4).lpf(sine.range(${hatcut}*.5, ${hatcut}).slow(32)), s("sh(7,16,<0 2 4 6>)").gain(.22)).fast(${rate}).orbit(1).play()
code.peak: stack(s("bd*4").bank("RolandTR909").shape(.3).gain(${gain}), s("~ cp ~ [cp <~ ~ ~ [~ cp]>]").bank("RolandTR909").gain(${gain}*.72).room(.15).lastOf(4, x=>x.fast(2)), s("[hh hh ~ hh] [~ hh hh hh] [hh ~ hh hh] [hh hh <hh oh> hh]").bank("RolandTR707").gain("[.55 .3 .42 .28]*4").late("[0 .018]*8").ply("<1 1 1 <1 2>>").lpf(sine.range(${hatcut}*.7, ${hatcut}*1.3).slow(16)), s("oh(3,8,<0 4 2 6>)").bank("RolandTR707").gain(.3).cut(1), s("sh*16").gain("[.3 .15 .22 .12]*4")).fast(${rate}).orbit(1).play()
